_comment: Well-known skrit INVOKE commands (ids 0x0000-0x7FFF). Canonical client catalog, mirrors the registry in PROTOCOL.md. The DEVICE'S InvokeDesc list is authoritative for what exists; this only enriches recognized ids with labels, descriptions, and UI widget hints. Unknown (vendor, >=0x8000) ids fall back to a generic form built from the device's arg signature. Loaded by the app UI (skrit.ts) and the MCP server.

commands.name: send_touch
commands.label: Send touch
commands.description: Inject a touch/tap at screen coordinate x,y. The device's handler decides how (e.g. capacitive spoof, digitizer).
